# vendor Opus Wasm

Generated by `npm run extract:opus-wasm` from `@audio/encode-opus` (libopus, MIT):

- `opus.wasm` — precompiled module for Cloudflare Workers
- `opus-emscripten.js` — emscripten glue (copied; package does not export it)

Workers cannot compile Wasm from an `ArrayBuffer` (`Wasm code generation disallowed by embedder`). The `.wasm` is imported as a `WebAssembly.Module` and passed to emscripten via `instantiateWasm`.
